subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw adopt lifecycle-owned prepared model-runtime generations as the canonical owner for model/auth/catalog discovery while retaining `loadModelCatalog` only as a deprecated Plugin SDK compatibility facade?
rationale: This changes the permanent runtime ownership model and a released SDK access path across agent, gateway, channels, media, and embedded execution; a mechanical review cannot choose the desired product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the lifecycle boundary
options.body: Approve prepared runtime generations as the canonical path and retain the compatibility wrapper under its stated deprecation contract.

options.title: Require a staged migration
options.body: Keep request-time behavior or a narrower compatibility contract until the SDK and lifecycle-owner direction is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Accept the lifecycle boundary
recommendation.body: Approve prepared runtime generations as the canonical path and retain the compatibility wrapper under its stated deprecation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit and PR history identify this person as the active contributor for the proposed lifecycle boundary and best routing point for the architecture decision.
